title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode7 Sending My Voice

meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: Shibuya Okuyama Building - Basement Hall
Stage

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Slowly... Be gentle with it and... Stop! Okay, we'll lift it onto the stage from here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This Christmas tree box is so heavy...!

rows.Speaker: Stage Staff A
rows.Line: Ow, my arms...!

rows.Speaker: Stage Staff B
rows.Line: It's too heavy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll prop this side up, so let's just keep trying! Ready? One, two... Three!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
We did it! Great work!
Once the lights get delivered, we'll put them together on the stage...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ah, perfect timing! That must be them with our lights! Let's go pick up our delivery...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
But this stage already has lights. Why do we need to borrow more from someone else...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is just the bare minimum.
We need more on the rafters and some extra spotlights if we want to make it feel like a real show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that makes sense...!
Wow, look at all the lights over there...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: These can really hurt someone if they were to fall on them, so please be careful! Don't carry too many at once if it feels too heavy!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, I've never seen a spotlight up so close... It kinda looks like a big bazooka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wake up, Minori! I need you to help me carry this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Uh... O-Okay!
One, two...!
Reception

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's move that table here.
Two put together should be enough.

rows.Speaker: Reception Staff
rows.Line:
Haruka! Shizuku!
P-Please, help...

rows.Speaker: Reception Staff
rows.Line: I was putting up this poster for the event and was just told by someone from the venue staff that we're not supposed to use this kind of tape...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you didn't try to use regular tape, did you...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That actually leaves behind some residue, so we should be using whatever tape they've allowed us to use. I'm pretty sure that was written in the agreement...

rows.Speaker: Reception Staff
rows.Line:
I... I didn't know...!
I'm so sorry. I've put up so many already...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
This is your first time and there's just so much to get used to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'm going to go help fix those posters. Can I leave you to set everything else up for the reception area?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I can do that!
I did this quite a lot when I was still in training, so you can count on me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll see you in a bit.
Venue entrance

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, the posters should be all set...!

rows.Speaker: Reception Staff
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Anyway, we should hurry back since we don't have much time left.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Basement Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I had a feeling that we'd be running behind schedule...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I thought we'd be okay since we didn't have any merchandise to worry about, but our staff's lack of experience is slowing us down more than I realized.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Shizuku, I'm back.
How are things over here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're all done. It took a little longer than I was hoping, but we all pulled together and managed to make a nice reception area.

rows.Speaker: Stage Staff
rows.Line:
Haruka! Shizuku!
If we don't start rehearsing for our show soon, we won't be able to stay on schedule...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, is it that time already?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's go, Shizuku.
We still need to talk things over with the lighting and sound techs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hnng... This light's so heavy...!
I didn't realize how hard it is to get these set up...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're not tired already, are you?
We still have to rehearse after this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shizuku and Haruka are here... Alright, let's start rehearsing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Hello, everyone...!
This is Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!...”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Huh? It went all quiet...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Stop!
Pause there please!

rows.Speaker: Sound Technician
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry!
I faded out there by accident...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That's okay! Let's just settle down and try it again!

rows.Speaker: Sound Technician
rows.Line:
But we're supposed to be rehearsing...
I should know what to do by now...

rows.Speaker: Lighting Technician
rows.Line: I apologize for switching lights at the wrong time too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, don't say that.
We should be the ones apologizing for not giving you a chance to rehearse sooner.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She's right...
It's our fault for booking this place and making you guys rehearse like this on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Exactly. None of you are to blame.
So let's regroup and check everything from the top again.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh no...
They seem so disappointed...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We've finished rehearsing but...)

rows.Speaker: Crowd Controller
rows.Line: If we let the line go this way, they'll spill out into the street so it might be better to break them into smaller lines...

rows.Speaker: Sound Technician
rows.Line: C-Can we go over that part once more?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The staff seem so worried...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, Airi, I have a feeling that everyone's a little tired right now... How about we all take a little break...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since we've been at it nonstop since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for the delay, everyone! I think it's high time we all took a break, so please take an hour to get yourselves some lunch and rest up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They seem really concerned...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this isn't looking good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Should we all sit down and discuss what's going on? Nothing good will come out of us fretting like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure you're tired too, Minori.
Sit tight. I'll get us something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, the ones we brought are all gone now, so I'll head up to the vending machines with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(What do we do...?
Isn't there anything I can do to help...?)

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: I never realized preparing for an event was this hard...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, they were the ones helping us put stuff together...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Yeah, hearing about how Haruka and the others were in trouble made me want to volunteer...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: But it feels like I'm not really doing much... Almost like I'm hurting more than helping...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: I'm gonna go use the restroom. I'm guessing we're going to be really busy once our break is over...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll go too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They were tearing up too...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're here to help us, but we made them feel this way...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And they have to work incredibly hard. They're the ones who move all the heavy equipment, set everything up and move around thousands of people at a time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By agreeing to have this person help us, we'd be making them “work” instead of having fun, no...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is what Haruka was talking about...)

Sorry I'm late!
Morning club activities went on longer than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?
Oh! Hi, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's you...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Fan
rows.Line:
Y-You're Minori, right?!
I can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Fan
rows.Line:
I am sure! I'm your fan, Minori!
Would it be okay if we shake hands...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're the one who asked to shake hands with me, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Fan
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
I can't believe that you remember me!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
Um, my name is Yuina Uchiyama!
I'm really looking forward to working with you today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yuina? It's nice to finally know your name! But wait... You're working with me today...?

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Yes, I applied at the last minute to participate as staff for this event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Really! I was busy with club activities this morning, but rushed over to help with what I could this afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, thank you so much for taking time out of your busy schedule like this...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But are you sure about doing this?! Being staff for an event like this is probably a lot harder than you expect!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Is it really that hard?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes... Even now, we're behind schedule and scrambling to figure things out...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Then, I'll just have to try my best...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: The way you shouted out to me during your last show stream gave me the courage to try harder for club.

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: That's why I want to return the favor, Minori. You helped me so I want to help you!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: I don't mind if it ends up being really hard! I'm happy as long as I know I'm helping you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yuina...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They're willing to endure all this if it means supporting us...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That means I...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yuina, thanks again for coming out today! I'm gonna head off for a little bit, so please wait for me in the hall!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: What?! Where are you going, Minori...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'm thinking about gathering everybody in the hall after we've all had something to eat...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel like we should talk to them and get them to relax since they seem to be worried right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds good.
It'll also be good to look everything over with the lighting and sound technicians again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we can also try talking to them individually during the break... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's going on? They're all moving toward the hall for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Look! Isn't that Minori on stage with a mic?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm going to spread and inspire hope in everyone with this event. That includes all the staff here too...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Everyone! Please allow me to thank you again for joining us here today!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Being able to put together an event with you like this is so incredible!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “But I also know that things haven't been going as planned. It's probably more work than some of you expected...”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “And I'm sorry for making you guys worry so much...”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Unlike Haruka, Shizuku or Airi, I've never done an event like this before, so I'm not really sure how to ease this tension...”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “But that's not gonna stop me from trying...!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “I'm still positive that we'll be able to put on an amazing and unforgettable event as long as we work together!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “You all made your way out here today just for us...”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “And that gave us an enormous boost of power!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “So as long as you're there to lend us your strength, we're going to try more and more and more! We're not stopping until it's over!”

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “I know it won't be easy, but I'm sure we can do it! We'll be fine as long as we work together!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “No matter how high a hurdle we face is, we're going to clear it! That's MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yeah, I think I was fretting over not being able to help out as much as I thought...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Me too...
I got so anxious about having to get all this done...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: We don't have much time until the curtains go up. Let's refocus and see this through...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like Minori beat us to it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's always there to push us in the right direction when we need it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we're not letting her take all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's get back to work and finish this!
